units.note: Alaska top-4 primary + RCV general; Dunleavy won a first-round majority so no RCV tabulation was needed. Charlie Pierce (R) withdrew but stayed on the ballot. Independent Bill Walker summed into D-side with Democrat Les Gara (both non-R, anti-Dunleavy). D-side sums Les Gara (Alaska Democratic Party) 63,851 + Bill Walker (Independent) 54,668. R-side sums Mike Dunleavy (Alaska Republican Party) 132,632 + Charlie Pierce (Alaska Republican Party) 11,817.
Ned Lamont: fusion lines Democratic Party (United States) + Working Families Party + Griebel-Frank for CT summed.

Kathy Hochul: fusion lines New York State Democratic Committee + Working Families Party summed. Lee Zeldin: fusion lines New York Republican State Committee + Conservative Party of New York State summed.
